questions3_answer.question3_1_answer: I decided to join the club because I wanted to meet new people, learn new skills, and participate in interesting activities. It seemed like a fun and engaging community to be a part of.
questions3_answer.question3_2_answer: I believe the club's membership fee is quite reasonable, as the diverse activities and benefits offered fully justify it. Furthermore, it is genuinely affordable, and the excellent variety of events certainly makes it worth the cost for me.

questions4_main: Dear member, All classes will be canceled next week. Because the instructor will go on holiday. Classes will be announced later. Fees won’t be refunded to the participants.
question4_1_text: Write a short email to your friend (about 50 words). Tell your friend your feelings about this and what you plan to do.
question4_2_text: Write an email to the president of the club (about 120-150 words). Tell them your thoughts about this and what you would like to do.
question4_1_text_answer:
Hi Linh,
I just heard that all classes are canceled next week because the instructor is going on holiday. I’m really disappointed as I was looking forward to attending. I plan to just wait for the next announcement. What will you do?
Best,
Phuong
question4_2_text_answer:
Dear Club President,
I am writing to convey my thoughts regarding the recent announcement of class cancellations next week due to the instructor's holiday. While I fully comprehend the circumstances, I must express my disappointment, as many members, including myself, highly value these lessons and eagerly anticipate them.
To maintain member engagement during this period, I propose organising alternative activities. For instance, informal practice sessions or guided discussions could be arranged, allowing participants to continue honing their skills and interacting.
Furthermore, I believe it would be beneficial for the club to provide members with greater advance notice regarding any future schedule changes. This would significantly help in managing expectations and enabling better personal planning for all.
Thank you for considering these suggestions. I look forward to learning more about the upcoming schedule and any potential adjustments.
Best regards,
Phuong
